title: chassalia singapurensis
intro: Chassalia singapurensis, commonly known as Singapore chassalia or Singapore chassalia plant, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine in Southeast Asia for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chassalia singapurensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and skin infections.
